chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Jamil, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

There should be three miles between the two congregations, meaning there is no Friday prayer except in what is between them; and the Friday prayer is not valid except with a sermon. He said: So when there are three miles between the two congregations in the Friday prayer, there is no harm if these [one group] hold a Friday prayer and those [the other group] hold a Friday prayer.
ai.seo_question: What is the required distance between two congregations for both to independently perform Friday prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the jurisprudential boundary for independent Friday congregations, establishing that a distance of three miles permits two separate groups to each perform Salat al-Jumu'ah with their own khutbahs. This ruling highlights the Shia emphasis on the communal and geographical dimensions of the Friday prayer, ensuring that the obligation is fulfilled locally without unnecessary burden on the faithful. It serves as a practical guideline for urban planning and community organization in Shia jurisprudence.
